notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43509051/2be22b52e81ca74e5f3e4cef995aaccc0d46d70c.png[/img]
[h3]Background Opacity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new "Background Opacity" slider to the Options menu. It defaults to 100% but can be adjusted from 0% to 100% to suit your preferences.
[*] The "Background Opacity" affects the 2D and 3D backgrounds, as well as the 2 parallax star layers.
[*] This feature should help players that experience readability and motion sickness issues on high detailed backgrounds.
[/list]

[/list]

[*] Hacked Mine, Seeking Bomb, Planet Attack & Elite Enemies will apply damage against themselves

[*] Manual Aiming causes hacked enemies to form a half circle shield in front of the player ship
[*] Upgrades
[list]
[*] Max Hacking Beams (5 Levels)
[*] Hacking Damage Multiplier (6 Levels)
[*] Hacking Hull Multiplier (4 Levels)
[*] Hacking Range (Optional) (4 Levels)

[*] Increased Elite Time Destroyer's movement speed in Endless mode to match speed in other game modes
